descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S20 Existing specs: All Residents search finds a resident who is not on today's list

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 Search over All Residents can add any resident to today. (UAT TC-09; TFA-92587 AC 4; TFA-92587 How it works 4)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given A resident with a unique token in the name / unit, not In Today

When Open /snf (not on Today's Visits), switch to All Residents, search partial, case-insensitive with spaces, then a no-match string, then clear

Then Absent from Today's Visits, found by the All Residents search (one result), 'No residents match…' for no match, back after clearing

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions in list-controls.spec.ts. This covers the 'search' half of U4 only; adding a search result to today is S02

Where it ran: datasets (seeded data sets, list checks) on dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S20 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-09.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; the triage is about a test issue and the result shown here is a full pass, so its status is kept.

Issue type: Test issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92587 ready for qa

Nothing is wrong for the physician: All Residents name search works. The red result comes from a superseded harness run in which the list jumped back to Today's Visits mid-test.

Evidence: The combined report ingested runs/2026-10-14-local/datasets/lists.prev (08:21Z). In that run the 'NAMEWA' search showed 0 cards, and the card did not come back after Clear. The current run (lists/evidence/TC-09-S20.json, 08:30Z) and datasets/results.json have TC-09/S20 passed 8/8. Datasets notes.json calls the 17:10 JST failure a harness false negative (the view re-mounted), fixed in setView/searchField. Lane A (list-controls.spec) passed, and dev U08 (TC-09 S02) passed. The ingest should read lists/, not lists.prev.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev, lane datasets (datasets/results.json, screenshots not attached).

Test method: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev/datasets.
